decisions.reason: As an in-platform sensor module for measurement applications, it fits the firm’s existing electronics, firmware and software capabilities, so management is likely to retain it and improve it rather than exit quickly.
This is a direct new generation of an existing voltage measurement product, which makes it highly related to the firm’s prior knowledge and therefore very unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
A CAN bus interface module is close to the firm’s established connectivity and embedded-control competences, so the firm should be able to learn from use and keep it in the platform.
A carbon dioxide sensor module extends the firm’s established sensing portfolio and can be supported by its in-house hardware, firmware and bindings, making continued commercialization likely.
